notes: Closed is treated as off and open as on. Four distinct movable parts are counted. The two cabinet doors are clearly opened separately, but their rapid closing sequence occurs between closely spaced samples, so the assignment of the approximately 316 and 324 closure midpoints to the individual leaves is less certain than the drawer timings.
scene_description: A compact kitchen containing a refrigerator, an overhead two-door cabinet, an oven, and drawer stacks on both sides of the oven.
